groups.title: Conversation
groups.desc: fillers, reactions, greetings, asking, news, thanks, saying no
groups.intro: The chunks that carry everyday conversation: filling pauses, reacting, greeting and asking. Start here.

sections.title: Fillers and softeners
sections.desc: Buy time while you think, and make what you say sound less blunt.

chunks.ex: It's a bit far, you know, so let's leave early.

chunks.use: correct or explain what you just said
chunks.ex: It's cheap — I mean, not cheap, but good value.
I'm kind of tired today.

chunks.use: when you are not being exact
chunks.ex: Let's grab a coffee or something.
I'd love to come. The thing is, I have to work.

chunks.use: before an honest, maybe unwelcome, opinion
chunks.ex: To be honest, I didn't like the film.
I guess we could try again tomorrow.

chunks.use: correct an assumption, or add a surprise
chunks.ex: Actually, I've never been there.

chunks.use: go back to the main topic
chunks.ex: Anyway, what were we talking about?
Let me think… maybe Friday?

chunks.use: start an answer, often a careful one
chunks.ex: Well, it's not that simple.
It was, like, really cold.

We talked about work, family, that sort of thing.

I'm more or less done.

chunks.c: at the end of the day

I'd say she's about thirty.

chunks.use: understand, even if you don't agree

groups.intro: Chunks that hold sentences together: linking ideas, talking about time, making plans, giving advice and handling problems.
